articleTitle: Enhancing Road Safety: The Role of Intelligent Driver Drowsiness Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The analysis of this research paper is touching the road safety concerns by focusing on developing a system which catches the drowsy state of the person who is driving which emerges as a big reason that causes up to 30due to this. Throughout the paper, the study discusses about literature review and various methodologies that include physiological, behavioural, and multimodal fusion approaches showing the evolution and history of drowsiness detection technologies. The methodology includes using of various sensor technologies and algorithms to collect data from the driver and process it to analyse data in real time. Eye movement and facial expressions are extracted which helps the system to identify signs of drowsiness with greater accuracy. When the driver is detected as drowsy a mechanism is triggered to alert the driver, averting accidents. Even with some challenges, the system is a big step towards increasing road safety utilizing advanced technologies to reduce the risk of driver fatigueless.

articleTitle: SoulCert - Decentralized and Secured Certification System Using Soul-Bound Non-fungible Token
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The paper introduces SoulCert, a decentralized application that leverages blockchain technology to address the challenges of academic certification. Utilizing soul-bound non-fungible tokens (NFTs), SoulCert provides a secure and transparent system for issuing, verifying, and managing tamper-proof academic credentials. The system extends the ERC721 standard with additional functionalities from ERC5192 for locking and unlocking tokens, ensuring the integrity and authenticity of certificates. The paper discusses various Ethereum token standards, their use cases, and the methodology behind SoulCert, highlighting its potential to revolutionize the academic certification process. The paper also presents performance comparison between different operation within SoulCert and economic feasibility for real world application.

articleTitle: Enhancing Campus Engagement with A Secure and Comprehensive Platform for Club Management and Student Participation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The council club operation serves as a centralized platform designed to grease and streamline the operation of colorful clubs within a council setting. With its primary focus on enhancing the commerce between clubs and scholars, this operation empowers clubs to register, modernize their biographies, and showcase their conditioning and events. It provides scholars with a comprehensive view of all available clubs, their objects, and forthcoming events, allowing flawless enrollment for these events. The core functionalities of this operation include club enrollment and profile operation, enabling clubs to modernize information about their identity, conditioning, and events. Access to these functionalities is eased for club officers, specifically the club chairman and the faculty counsel, icing effective and controlled operation of club related content. Core navigators of the operation, primarily scholars, have the capability to explore a different array of clubs, view club details, and register for club hosted events. By furnishing a stoner-friendly interface and intuitive navigation, the operation aims to foster increased engagement, participation, and connectivity within the council community. Crucial features of the operation encompass stoner biographies containing essential information, club biographies showcasing club details and events, and a streamlined event enrollment system. These features inclusively aim to produce an interactive ecosystem that encourages pupil involvement in colorful club conditioning and fosters a sense of community within the council terrain. Overall, the council club operation serves as a vital tool that not only simplifies executive tasks for clubs but also enriches the pupil experience by offering a comprehensive platform for club engagement and event participation within the council community.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Powered Certificate Authentication: Enhancing Trust and Transparency
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: In this study, a blockchain-based Decentralized Application (DApp) for certificate authentication and verification from accredited colleges or certification bodies is presented. The DApp uses decentralized ledger technology, built on the Ethereum blockchain and smart contracts, to guarantee the integrity and authenticity of digital certificates. It uses a number of technologies, including Streamlit, Ganache-cli, Truffle, Pinata (for IPFS), and Docker, to expedite the certificate validation process and lower the risk of manipulation and forgery. The Institute, which is in charge of awarding certifications, and the Verifier, which is in charge of providing strong verification procedures, are the two primary players in the system. By utilizing Pinata, IPFS improves certificate permanence and accessibility without depending on centralized data storage. The advantages of blockchain attributes such as immutability, transparency, and decentralization in building confidence in the certification and education domains are empirically demonstrated. Future studies will concentrate on compatibility with other blockchain ecosystems, scalability, and smart contract efficiency. All things considered, this work provides a framework for safe document verification and recommends blockchain-based DApps as a remedy for data security and integrity in a variety of industries.

articleTitle: Verdict Prediction using Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence is making tremendous improvements in the judiciary system in various roles such as Verdict Prediction, Case Prioritization, and Recommendation Systems, among others. Various systems have been developed to automate the process of Verdict Prediction. Often, the judiciary may fail to deliver justice to common people due to corruption or other factors. This is one of the drawbacks in the modern judiciary system, where the verdict can be influenced by wealth. However, an automated system accessible to everyone can ensure a just verdict, thus increasing transparency. There are approximately 41,861,760 pending cases in the Supreme Court [16], and many of these cases can be resolved with fewer hearings. Consequently, a model has been constructed using neural networks to expedite and enhance accuracy. Through Natural Language Processing and deep learning, we have created a model that takes textual information about facts and evidence and provides the result of the winner and the appropriate punishment, along with a valid explanation. Utilizing NLTK libraries, the model has been trained on a vast amount of information about different cases using various neural networks, including CNN, RNN, and other simple neural networks. The stored model is employed for predicting the winner. Employing explanation-agnostic models, the sentences contributing to the result are displayed, and these sentences are subsequently sent to a model trained using the Indian Penal Code dataset to determine the punishment to be given to the culprit. This streamlined process optimizes court proceedings and ensures timely resolutions.

articleTitle: Opcode based malware detection using Stacked Recurrent Neural Networks and Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Malwares is designed to infiltrate devices and in most cases the underlying operating system and are packaged in multiple file formats. Considering that Windows operating system is one of the most opted operating systems worldwide in this paper we are focusing on developing a PE file malware detection system using Stacked CNN and RNN. In this paper we are training a LSTM and GRU model along a CNN model to detect malware PE files. We are using two techniques for comparing the results, we are using the DikeDataset which is an open source active dataset for collecting malware and benign files. Further we are employing static analysis using the opcode frequency based malware detection technique. Further we are exploring the Blue Hexagon Open Dataset for Malware AnalysiS (BODMAS) dataset which is a comprehensive dataset maintained for 57,293 malware samples and 77,142 benign samples and 581 malware families and the EMBER dataset.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Transportation Network for the Brain based on Observed Driving Patterns
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: This Connected autonomous vehicle can effectively overcome the perceived limitations of human drivers through the use of communication and artificial intelligence technology. However, due to the high dynamics of the vehicular network and the various disruptions and handovers that occur, providing solid communication lines between cars is still difficult, and this might have disastrous consequences. This work proposes a technique for intelligently grouping vehicles in the heterogeneous Cognitive Internet of Vehicles based on their driving behaviours (CIoVs). The driving mode with numerous feature parameters is analysed in the proposed method to precisely capture driving traits. With the goal of facilitating trustworthy clustering of networked autonomous cars, a method based on neural network pattern recognition and the principles of evolutionary algorithms is developed. The cognitive engines can identify the different driving styles and cluster cars that share that style together. We also study the clustering mechanism's communication performance and construct the stability and life duration of clusters. Data from simulations shows that associated to state-of-the-art methods, the suggested mechanism increases reliable communication throughput by around 14.4% and average cluster lifespan by about 11.5%.

articleTitle: A Deep Residual Network-Based Approach to Reidentify Persons via Face Features Extraction from Video Frames
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The rise of unwanted situations in today's environment has made video security more important. Video surveillance helps with anomaly identification and improves security in a number of areas, such as businesses, educational institutions, and city monitoring systems. The task of recognizing and re-identifying moving subjects, particularly those captured by many cameras, are extremely difficult and are made more problematic by things like low-quality video, inconsistent illumination, and congested spaces. A model database, a feature descriptor, and a classifier are three essential elements of digital image processing that are used in the process of identifying people in video. This document aims to give a general summary of the procedures utilized in video footage-based person re-identification (Re-ID) The arena of person Re-ID study includes a range of approaches and techniques. These methods include the identification of faces through feature recognition, the creation of detailed profiles through multiple component matching representations, and the use of multiple component dissimilarity representations to capture the subtleties of a person's appearance. Using deep residual networks is one noteworthy method that has shown to be remarkably effective in extracting face characteristics. After these traits are recovered, they may be used to compare and match people's faces between various video frames and camera angles. In addition, an innovative deep learning-based technique for person Re-ID using face traits is presented in the research. Furthermore, the research examines the main obstacles related to human Re-ID in video surveillance and considers possible ways to overcome these obstacles.

articleTitle: Comparison Of Emotion Through Text Analysis Using Various Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: In this study, we investigate the efficacy of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), Long Short-Term Memory networks (LSTM), and Bidirectional LSTMs (BiLSTM) for emotion classification tasks, which are crucial in natural language processing for applications ranging from sentiment analysis to mental health monitoring. After preprocessing textual data and encoding it into numerical representations suitable for deep learning models, we train multiple architectures with varied configurations and hyperparameters. Evaluation based on accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score reveals distinct strengths and weaknesses of each model. CNNs excel in capturing local features, RNNs adeptly model sequential dependencies, LSTM networks overcome vanishing gradient issues for long-range dependencies, and BiLSTMs outperform by incorporating bidirectional information flow, enhancing contextual understanding. Our findings offer valuable insights into selecting appropriate deep learning models for emotion analysis, advancing the state-of-the-art in these fields, and guiding practitioners in their applications.

articleTitle: Advanced Robotics: Exploring AI and IoT in Multi-Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The combination of electromyography (EMG) and electroencephalography (EEG) sensors with Internet of Things (IoT) enabled robots has marked a turning point in human-robot interaction. This chapter examines the groundbreaking potential of this integration and shows how contemporary technology and physiological signals are convergent. Results indicate improved sensory integration, allowing robots to interpret environmental cues and human intention with unprecedented precision. Although real-time feedback techniques increase efficiency and safety, complex signal processing and ethical challenges persist. Still, research toward a future where robotics, IoT, EMG, and EEG all work together to revolutionize human-machine collaboration in various circumstances is stimulated by the promise of personalized prostheses, easily navigable assistive devices, and extensible systems. Interaction between humans and machines is being transformed by robots because EMG and EEG sensors are integrated into IoT-connected robotic systems, and they can comprehend physical orders through EMG signals and read cognitive intent through EEG signals. Scholars are working to enhance signal processing algorithms to lower noise and increase the accuracy and reliability of brain signal interpretation as they become more aware of the possible uses of IoT-integrated EMG and EEG sensors in robotics.

articleTitle: Autonomous Areial Surveillance System For Flood Rescue Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: In the profile of rising challenges in flood and glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF) scenarios, the national disaster response force (NDRF) encounters significant administrative obstacles during rescue missions. This project introduces a disruptive solution through the implementation of autonomous drones provide with advanced technologies to support and optimize rescue working in flood-prone regions. The system's primary objective is to provide a cost-effective and prompt means of obtaining aerial data over expansive areas. Autonomous drones take center stage, executing surveillance missions that generate invaluable heatmaps of water levels and complicated 3D Geomaps. These visual helps to prove instrumental in enhancing the precision and effectiveness of mission planning, providing rescue teams with crucial insights into the topography of the affected areas. The communication and control hub, acting as a Central Processing Unit, plays a vital role in ensuring the precision landing of drones and facilitating ideal communication between the drone and a dedicated mobile application – JARVIS.

articleTitle: Eyes on Health: A Deep Learning Approach for Ocular or Eyes Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: At present, eye conditions or eye diseases are the primary reason for blindness and vision loss around the globe. Identifying and forecasting eye illnesses with conventional techniques are difficult, lengthy, and susceptible to human mistakes. Any delay in identifying and foreseeing future issues will lead to the patient losing their eyesight or experiencing vision problems. In order to prevent this, we require a system that is capable of detecting and predicting eye diseases with effectiveness, efficiency, and automation. In this article, we developed a computerized system using a pre-existing EfficientNetB3 CNN family structure to detect eye diseases through deep learning technology. The dataset utilized in this research was obtained at no cost from the web and comprises 4,217 pictures. The model was trained with transfer learning and enhanced with an improved dataset through augmentation methods. Precision score, Recall score, and F1-score and accuracy are utilized for assessing the model’s performance. Our findings indicate that the EfficientNetB3 model performs better than conventional CNN structures, achieving high precision in identifying various eye diseases. The accuracy of model 97% on the training dataset and 95% on the test dataset by incorporating image augmentation. We utilized characteristics from the EfficientNetB3 structure, tailored for identification and categorization in image datasets.

articleTitle: Tamper-forgery Image Detection in Security Digital Image: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Concerns with image security exist in every sector that uses digital photographs. Historically, public safety and forensics have depended on images from the crime scene, biometric photos, suspect photos, and other sources. With the development of digital imaging, there has been a significant increase in the use of digital images in this field. Although the use of digital image processing has led to the creation of several new forensic methods of inquiry, it has also simplified picture modification. Digital picture validity is an issue since several snipping and image alteration programs are freely available to the public. It serves as solid proof in many different types of crimes and is utilized as documentation for many purposes. Creating and modifying photos has become easier and more accessible with the development of image manipulation and editing tools. The two most common methods of photo counterfeiting are copy-and-move forgery and image splicing. An image can be spliced, or combined from two photos, to hide or show an error scenario. A section of a picture can be copied and pasted into another image. The many kinds of digital image frauds are examined in this study along with software that detects them. An analysis was done on the methods currently in use for spotting phony photos.

articleTitle: Deep Transfer Learning Approach to Detect Dragon Tree Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Dragon fruit cultivation in Bangladesh is steadily growing. Farmers are increasingly interested in planting dragon fruit in cropland at the marginal level. The cost is little and the yield is simply achieved with great efficiency. With the rising output of the fruit, its cultivation is likewise steadily increasing. Consequently, a multitude of ailments affecting the dragon tree are emerging. A significant number of trees are perishing prior to the growth of dragon fruit. Hence, we offer a sophisticated deep-learning model capable of accurately detecting and classifying different diseases affecting dragon fruit. For this particular instance, we utilized 6000 photographs that were captured manually using our mobile device. We have identified three prevalent diseases that affect dragon fruits: Anthracnose, Root rot, and Stem canker. I have also acquired a recently harvested dragon fruit. Four distinct models have been selected in this instance. These options are Restnet50, VGG16, CNN, and VGG19. All the models yielded satisfactory results, however, VGG19 exhibited exceptional performance. The VGG19 model achieved an accuracy of 92%. This is an excellent outcome. The device successfully identified three diseases that impact dragon fruit trees and was also capable of detecting freshly harvested dragon fruit. The practical application of this technology will result in a transformation within the community of dragon farmers. Implementing this measure will enhance farmers’ crop production while reducing mortality rates among dragon trees.

articleTitle: YouTube Video Summarizer Using ASR
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Platforms like YouTube have revolutionized the way people distribute and consume information in the video-dominated digital age. However, viewers who are trying to get pertinent information quickly may find it difficult due to the sheer volume of videos. This research describes a system for summarizing YouTube videos that effectively extracts information using Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) and Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) analysis. ASR translates audio to text, and TF-IDF finds the most important information for brief summaries. Empirical validation supports the optimization of usability through automation and personalization. The technology facilitates navigation through large amounts of video footage by supporting Natural Language processing (NLP) and information retrieval.

articleTitle: Improving Workstation Ergonomics using Posture Detection for Corporate Professionals
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Extended periods of sitting in corporate environments have been known to lead to a lot of health concerns, including lower back aches and neck strain. This sedentary lifestyle not only put employees’ well-being at risk but also hinders overall work efficiency and job satisfaction. These detrimental effects of prolonged sitting necessitate an intervention to mitigate these issues and enhance workplace health. The proposed application seamlessly integrates into the work environment by using camera input from the device’s webcam and MediaPipe Pose for posture detection and correction. It delivers personalized prompts and reminders, fostering user awareness and enabling self-improvement. Through this comprehensive approach, which includes promoting breaks to address the detrimental effects of prolonged sitting, this solution creates a healthier and more productive workplace. Moreover, the application prioritizes user privacy by performing all computations locally on the user’s device. This on-device processing not only safeguards privacy but also allows for uninterrupted operation even in the absence of an internet connection.

articleTitle: Fractional Discrete Cosine Transform and Chaotic Based Encryption for Medical Image Security
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The reliability of medical images is paramount for accurate diagnosis and treatment planning. However, medical images are susceptible to manipulation, raising concerns about their authenticity and integrity. This paper proposes a novel encryption system to verify the reliability of medical images using Fractional Discrete Cosine Transform and chaotic functions. The proposed system encrypts medical images using FrDCT to transform the image into the frequency domain. Subsequently, a chaotic function is employed to scramble the transformed coefficients, enhancing the security of the encryption process. The chaotic function like logistic maps introduces more randomness into the encrypted image, making it resistant to various attacks. The proposed system offers several advantages, including high encryption strength, robustness against noise, and the ability to perform decryption and reliability verification without the original image.

articleTitle: Harnessing Artificial Intelligence and Robotics to Combat Water Hyacinth Invasion for Sustainable Environment : A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Water hyacinth (Eichhornia crassipes), an aquatic free-floating plant, is highly invasive and can now be found in most freshwater bodies in the world's subtropical and tropical climates. Because of the potential harm these plants do to the environment and civilization, it is critical to track their seasonality and spatial distribution in order to develop effective prevention techniques at an early stage. With an emphasis on the application of machine learning algorithms and image analysis techniques for weed detection, this study investigates and examines the usage of artificial intelligence (AI) to overcome these difficulties. Sophisticated algorithms such as the Single Shot Detector (SSD) approach are used for real-time object detection, as well as the integration of machine learning techniques such as CART, RF, and SVM, CNN, and KNN helps for object detection. Modern advances in robotics and artificial intelligence (AI) have shown promise in addressing issues related to the environmental challenges. This review examines prior studies, innovative methodologies, and case studies to identify gaps, challenges, and opportunities for future study and application for controlling the growth of water hyacinth.

articleTitle: ShareBloc:A Unified Ecosystem for Secure File Sharing and Decentralized Value Exchange
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving landscape of digital transactions and digital sharing, efficient and secure information exchange is paramount. With the exponential growth of the global Blockchain Market size, due to increase in digital transactions and file sharing, a streamlined decentralized information management has never been more pressing. Over the period of time, different methods have been proposed to perform decentralized tasks like Money transfer, File sharing, Crowd funding, etc. But navigating to different platforms to perform distinct tasks presents a significant hurdle for users. To tackle this challenge, we present a novel solution named ShareBloc: a comprehensive blockchain-based platform integrating file sharing and cryptocurrency transfers, with a vision to share anything and everything in a decentralized manner. Since blockchain transactions are transparent and immutable but one common drawback is the lack of privacy and the pseudonymous nature of addresses used in public blockchains. This may possibly lead to tracing transactions back to specific addresses, potentially revealing sensitive information about the user. Hence, we aim to implement access control mechanisms through ownership and access lists, allowing users to control the access of their uploaded files which in turn improves the privacy of shared data.

articleTitle: Jewellery Supply Chain Management using Hyperledger Fabric
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Quality and quantity plays a vital role in Jewellery stores, the main part for a store is maintaining the quality and quantity of the product. The solution for this is to use Blockchain. Blockchain was firstly used for maintaining records or transactions of the peers. Blockchain is highly secured technology which provides distributed records maintenance and advanced level of encryption and also provides distributed database. In this paper we have proposed a proper system to maintain proper traceability and full transparency in supply chain, the system provides proper maintenance of all the records maintained by the parties. We designed this system very intelligently to provide an architecture for three main factors, the manufacturers, middlemen and store owners, who will get proper information about their assets or products at any time. This system also contains certifying authorities that will help maintain authenticity in the system. Private blockchain gives us various advantages such as maintaining proper traceability for authenticated users and maintaining the records in private databases with security features like hashing. This system helps us solve main problems in the supply chain of assets i.e proper tracking of packages which in turn helps us maintain good quality and quantity of products.

articleTitle: Incentivized Blockchain-based Decentralized E-Waste Management: A Sustainable Model for Green Computing and Circular Economy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The proliferation of technology, while enhancing convenience and innovation, has engendered a formidable ecological challenge electronic waste (e-waste). Improper disposal practices, toxic components, and the sheer volume of discarded electronics imperil the planet. In response, a pioneering decentralized platform has emerged, poised to revolutionize e-waste recycling. This platform meticulously records electronic purchases and user data, offering comprehensive tracking of device lifecycles. Notably, it incentivizes responsible disposal, motivating users to participate in eco-friendly recycling or disposal measures by offering rewards like discounts on future electronic purchases. Customers will receive valuable incentives each time they recycle a unit, and they can access these rewards through their e-wallets. To create an e-wallet, all that’s required is to provide their email address. Moreover, the platform champions the concept of a circular electronics economy, promoting device reuse, refurbishment, and recycling. By harnessing this decentralized platform, the aim is to mitigate the environmental repercussions of e-waste and champion sustainable electronic device consumption and disposal practices. This innovative solution offers environmental benefits and valuable incentives, establishing a symbiotic system that promises a more sustainable future.

articleTitle: Battery Optimization Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The ever-growing mountain of e-waste, fueled by short-lived batteries, threatens our planet's security. Discarded batteries leach toxic materials, jeopardizing environmental health and safety. This escalating crisis demands a paradigm shift. This research proposes a groundbreaking solution: leveraging Machine Learning to optimize battery lifecycles, dramatically reducing waste and its associated environmental security risks.Our work integrates advancements in solid-state electrolytes with data-driven ML techniques to enhance battery management, contributing to sustainable security solutions. We employ clustering algorithms to categorize batteries for targeted optimization and implement regression models to predict and mitigate battery degradation. Our approach goes beyond traditional capacity and voltage metrics, incorporating crucial factors like temperature and depth of discharge for a holistic E-waste security assessment.This research paves the way for a secure and sustainable future by establishing a critical link between AI and responsible e-waste management. By promoting collaboration between researchers, policymakers, and consumers, we can leverage technology to decouple our reliance on electronics from the environmental burden of battery waste. This work presents a powerful solution with immense potential to secure a cleaner and more sustainable future.

articleTitle: Blockchain based Cloud storage drive platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The advent of blockchain technology has revolutionized various sectors by introducing decentralized and secure systems. This paper presents a novel approach to developing a blockchain-based Drive system using React, Solidity, Hardhat, and IPFS for file storage. By leveraging blockchain’s immutability and distributed nature, coupled with IPFS’s decentralized file storage, the proposed system aims to enhance data security, integrity, and accessibility compared to traditional centralized solutions. The integration of React ensures a user-friendly interface, while Solidity and Hardhat facilitate smart contract development and deployment on the Ethereum blockchain. This paper discusses the architecture, implementation, and potential benefits of the proposed system in the context of file storage and sharing.

articleTitle: Enhancing Privacy using DNA based Data Hiding
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: In today’s digital era, the safeguarding of sensitive information against unauthorized access and interception is of paramount importance. Methods for concealing data, such as cryptography and steganography, are essential for upholding the privacy, integrity, and validity of digital information. Among these techniques, DNA-based steganography emerges as a promising approach, leveraging the unique properties of DNA sequences to encode and conceal digital information within pseudo-DNA carriers. This paper provides a review of data hiding methodologies, with a specific focus on DNA-based steganography. Through an analysis of existing literature, this paper explores the principles, techniques, and applications of DNA steganography across various cover media, including audio, image, linguistics, and video. Additionally, this paper proposes a taxonomy for the DNA-based methodologies for data hiding and aims to contribute to the advancement of information security and privacy preservation in the digital age by identifying potential challenges and opportunities for further research.

articleTitle: A Novel Simulated Approach to Secure Multi-Tenant Distributed Systems using Anomaly Score based Virtual Machine Live Migration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Now a days, cloud computing services are being used exponentially which in turn increases in multi-tenant distributed service(MTDS). Targeted attacks in MTDS propagated through side channel, shared memories, network access, and configuration. These attacks could be discovered after analyzing side channel data. This paper proposes a novel anomaly approach for virtual machine placement (VM) considering anomaly scores of VM and the CPU utilization of the servers. The result reveals that the proposed approach ensures secure VM migrations among the servers during VM placement, and also ensures that the MTDS environment remains secure.

articleTitle: E-Commerce and Supply-chain using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The advent of online shopping has revolutionized the way people procure goods, favoring the convenience and efficiency it offers over traditional stores. However, this transition to e-commerce comes with its own set of challenges. Instances of security breaches, where hackers exploit vulnerabilities in e-commerce platforms to steal sensitive user data, have become increasingly common. Additionally, concerns over privacy arise as some companies monetize user data, leaving individuals susceptible to various online threats such as phishing scams and spam communications.Another key disadvantage of current e-commerce systems is a lack of transparency in the supply chain, which frequently leaves consumers unsure about the legitimacy and condition of the products they buy. To address these issues, we propose the development of a decentralized marketplace. By leveraging blockchain technology, specifically Ethereum, and implementing smart contracts to govern transactions, we aim to create a platform where the supply chain is transparent to all involved parties. Instead of relying on traditional email addresses and passwords, users will utilize Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs) to authenticate themselves within the system. This innovative approach seeks to enhance security, protect user privacy, and instill trust in online transactions.

articleTitle: CollabCodeX: An Effective Platform for Enhancing the Teaching-Learning Experience
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: As coding becomes a crucial skillset in the curriculum of any software stream, there is a need for a dedicated tool in the classroom. Educators and students need access to a collaborative coding environment where both can code and interact in real time. This project aims to create a comprehensive collaborative coding platform tailored to meet the needs of teachers and students. We aim to overcome the limitations of existing collaborative coding solutions that lack dedicated features for education purposes. The platform will feature a suite of robust tools and functionalities designed to enhance the collaborative coding experience. Real-time collaboration capabilities will allow multiple users to work simultaneously on multiple programming languages, facilitating seamless coordination. Apart from this, the platform will also feature tools to allow for immediate review and grading of codes and tools for code analysis and interaction between student and teacher.

articleTitle: DefendNet: Harnessing AI/ML for Dynamic DNS Filtering and Network Security
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The ubiquitous nature of the Internet has changed the nature of interaction, business, and work, but it has also provided an easy way for people with bad intentions to take advantage of the vulnerable system and use it for evil activities. Compromising the DNS backbone is an example of malwares and botnets’ capabilities of exploiting the infrastructure of the Internet. DNS-based attacks are more evolved now than ever before. In addition to this, traditional defense mechanisms like rule-based approaches and threat intelligence feeds are immensely limited in scope and ability to deal with evolving cyber threats which makes individuals and organizations susceptible to newer cyber-attacks. To provide an efficient solution for these problems, this paper proposes a machine learning and ensemble model technique for enhanced DNS security. The proposed system implements the ensemble learning approaches, particularly Gradient Boosting Machines (GBM), XGBoost, and CatBoost, along with sophisticated preprocessing techniques and optimization methods to maximize the precision and performance of the model. Real-time threat detection and alert systems teamed with a user-friendly dashboard, empower users by giving them all the necessary know-how for safeguarding their digital assets effectively. Given architecture integrates components such as API or Proxy, Local Cache and Whitelisting, Blacklisting, Website Scanner and Antivirus Engines, and Machine Learning Model to create a robust defense mechanism against such cyber threats. Through a meticulously designed workflow, the system intercepts DNS requests, conducts real-time analysis and filtering, and employs machine learning models to detect malicious domains, ensuring secure browsing experiences for users while mitigating risks associated with malicious URLs. The solution emphasizes improving the throughput and decreasing the latency of DNS requests and response times. By optimizing the processing pipeline & employing efficient algorithms, the system aims to expedite the resolution process and minimize the time it takes to serve DNS requests. Overall, our system employs machine learning and ensemble techniques to push DNS security to the next level, but at the same time gives priority to data throughput and reduces the latency to improve the performance of the system, making the digital assets secure for cyber security and satisfactory user experience.

articleTitle: Empowering Healthcare: Hyperledger Blockchain for Unified Electronic Health Records and Organ Donation Integrity
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: This paper proposes the integration of blockchain technology, specifically Hyperledger Fabric, to address challenges in organ donation management and electronic health records (EHRs) sharing. Blockchain's inherent features such as transparency, immutability, and decentralization are leveraged to streamline organ procurement processes, mitigate fraud, and build trust among stakeholders. Our framework includes organ tracking, consent verification, and secure data sharing among medical institutions through smart contracts, ensuring automation while maintaining data privacy and patient confidentiality. This solution is designed to accommodate the modern trend of seeking healthcare services from multiple providers, providing patients ownership of their EHRs and enabling seamless transfer across hospitals. By empowering healthcare providers with a unified system for organ donation integrity and EHR management, our approach aims to enhance collaboration, reduce administrative burdens, and improve the efficiency of organ transplantation systems, all while ensuring data security and promoting continuity of care.

articleTitle: Secure and Transparent Blockchain Donations: An Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) Framework for Enhanced Donor Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) framework tailored for blockchain philanthropy platforms, addressing the limitations of traditional Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) systems. Utilizing a consortium blockchain network, the framework ensures secure and transparent management of charitable donations, enabling donor control and aligning contributions with philanthropic goals. Cryptographic techniques enforce access control policies based on donor attributes, enhancing security and accountability. Experimental results demonstrate the framework’s efficiency, low storage, computation overheads, scalability, and ability to handle moderate transaction volumes effectively. Future research will focus on integrating the system with existing platforms and exploring privacy-preserving ABAC techniques.

articleTitle: Detecting plagiarism using Latent Semantic Analysis and Cosine Similarity Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The act of using someone else’s words and/or ideas and passing them off as your own is known as plagiarism. The act of presenting one’s own thoughts or works as those of another person. Plagiarism, that point, is the willful taking of another person’s thoughts, words, or works. Finding instances of plagiarism and/or copyright violations in a work or document is what a plagiarism tool achieves. We are developing an Offline Plagiarism Tool to avoid plagiarism. This research employs latent semantic analysis and cosine similarity to compare the papers' similarity. must steer clear of any accidental or purposeful plagiarism. To arrange tasks by employing these tools to obtain the similarity score to ensure that the text is truly approved by the organizations and to prevent errors in paraphrase. Two strategies have been built to determine the similarity score of documents based on word matching and semantic meaning.This tool additionally shows to the user the percentage of plagiarism in their document and the necessity for changes in an eye-catching graphical format. This procedure will undoubtedly assist in determining whether or not content has been duplicated, and user-generated datasets have been gathered for this purpose. It aids in improving the ability to organize and paraphrase text as well as to show different graphs so that the user can quickly comprehend the outcomes.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based Goods Authentication System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The rapid increase of counterfeit products in the markets have put the brand reputation at high risk with consumers loosing trust in brand quickly. This makes it difficult to manage customer relationships. The blockchain being immutable and decentralized guarantees that all the product information stored on it, is secured and verified throughout the product life cycle.In this paper, we propose a novel approach of the One time Password (OTP) consisting of unique code that private to each consumers, send via email. Incorporation of QR code scanning is implemented for product authentication as both the data in QR code and consumer code are securely stored on the blockchain.Products authentication is made easy and hassle-free which helps to build trust. The solution, being scalable and portable, ensures that it is platform independent.Combining all these technological advantages, this blockchain-based system provides a robust solution to reduce the use of fake products by protecting both the consumers and manufacturers from facing adverse effects of these counterfeit products in the market.

articleTitle: Detection of Fake Physical Certificates using a Blockchain-Based Certificate Verification and Issuer Validation System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Fraudulent educational degree certificates can have a catastrophic impact on employers. This can also cause serious problems for educational institutions during admission into higher-degree programmes. Although some research has been done to validate the authenticity of certificates, the challenge persists in having a tamper-proof and low-cost solution where the certificate issuer and the certificates are validated in a single integrated platform. This paper proposes an integrated blockchain-based decentralized model for certificate verification and issuer validation. Along with this, it will protect the certificates from being tampered with. The proposed solution is tested by creating an Ethereum-like transparent blockchain. The performance of the proposed solution is measured by the execution and transaction cost in terms of Gas consumption and a comparison of the proposed approach against existing methods is provided. It is observed that the cost of adding a certificate is the lowest in the case of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Blockchain-RFID Integrated Model for Preventing Counterfeit Migration in Post-Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Counterfeit products pose significant risks to public health, consumer safety, and the integrity of supply chains. This paper presents a Blockchain Model of Ownership Record System (BMORS) for combating counterfeiting in the post-supply chain. BMORS is based on a novel approach by integrating Radio-Frequency Identification (RFID) technology with the blockchain. By leveraging RFID tags, we capture detailed product information at each stage of the supply chain, ensuring real-time data collection. This information is securely stored on a blockchain, creating a decentralized, transparent, and immutable ledger of transactions. The blockchain-based system automates verification processes through smart contracts, enhancing the traceability and authenticity of products. Consumers, manufacturers, distributors, and regulatory authorities can access these tamper-resistant transactions to confirm product ownership and history of ownership, thus significantly reducing the incidence of counterfeit goods. Our implementation on the Ethereum platform demonstrates the cost-effectiveness and reliability of this solution, with performance evaluations indicating that transaction management remains efficient even upon increasing the number of ownership transfers. This research underscores the potential of combining RFID and blockchain technologies to ensure product authenticity, enhance consumer trust, and streamline post-supply chain operations. The proposed system offers a robust framework for future work in anti-counterfeit measures and supply chain management.

articleTitle: A Novel Counterfeit-proof, Traceable, and Cost efficient Drug Supply Chain using Ethereum Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The integrity and efficiency of drug supply chain management represents pivotal concerns in contemporary pharmaceutical discourse. It is imperative to design innovative solutions that can overcome the existing challenges of drug supply chain such as, counterfeit drugs, supply chain vulnerabilities, and regulatory complexities. In response, this research explores the transformative potential of blockchain technology in fortifying and optimizing drug supply chain operations. The proposed Ethereum blockchain-based solution has procedure to avoid counterfeit drugs, and to trace the journey of drug. Our framework promises to engender trust, enhance regulatory oversight, and safeguard public health interests. We have conducted the security and cost analysis of executed smart contract to evaluate the effectiveness of contract.

articleTitle: Performance Validation of Server-Less Computing Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: A promising paradigm for developing scalable and affordable cloud applications is serverless computing. However, because of their dynamic nature and intrinsic complexity, evaluating the performance of serverless platforms presents difficulties. With the use of machine learning techniques, this research offers a novel method for performance validating serverless computing environments. The machine learning models that can forecast performance under different workloads and setups are then trained using these metrics. Stakeholders can learn more about the behavior of serverless systems and adjust their applications accordingly by using this predictive modeling. The performance analysis carried out in the paper probably includes several variables, including throughput, scalability, reaction time, cost efficiency, and resource use. The authors aim to provide a relative performance of serverless edge computing systems by comparing these measures between various frameworks. Experiments are carried out on distinct serverless platforms, such as Kubeless, OpenFaas, Fission, and funX, to confirm the efficacy of the suggested methodology. The outcomes show how accurate and adaptable our prediction algorithms are at projecting performance indicators for various platforms and workload circumstances. Overall, by providing a methodical approach to performance assessment, this research advances serverless computing and helps cloud service providers and developers make more educated decisions.

articleTitle: AI Powered Resource Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The ongoing problem of manual data entry in education has a novel answer in the form of the AI-Powered Resource Management System. Through the use of cutting-edge technologies and deep learning, it transforms the processing of invoices while lowering errors and streamlining operations. The Vosk speech recognition toolkit makes voice querying simple, increasing automation and accessibility. Users can now interact with invoice data using natural language commands, freeing them up to focus on strategic duties. The system additionally incorporates liveness detection using OpenCV for authentication in order to guarantee robust security. The adaptable architecture of educational institutions ensures interoperability with emerging technologies, positioning them at the forefront of efficient data administration. With improved operational efficiency, accuracy, and decision-making capabilities, a new era of resource management is anticipated with the use of this technology.

articleTitle: TeleForensic: Delving into Digital Evidence with CDR Forensics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Call Data Records (CDR) are important evidence in cases involving cybercrime and crimes such as murder and robbery. Nonetheless, analyzing CDR is arduous work because the amount of data is enormous, and if a person does not know where to look, they would overlook valuable information. In today's world, officials do their best to solve crimes, but as the phrase goes, every piece of evidence counts, and CDR is no exception. This research investigates the many processes and techniques used in the analysis of CDR data, particularly in the context of telecommunications, including data analytics, pattern matching, geographical mapping, and visualization methods. Furthermore, the paper covers problems and prospects in CDR forensic analysis, emphasizing the importance of improved tools and approaches to deal with growing communication technologies and increasing cyber threats.

articleTitle: Mobile Application to Help Abandoned Pets
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: As social beings, humans like to interact with each other, including other creatures of God, such as animals, and keep them as pets. Many pets, such as dogs, cats, birds, fish, rabbits, and so on, include unusual pets such as reptiles, pigs, insects, etc. As a result of the lack of human awareness of pets and the nature of keeping animals, which is only for fun, it is not soulful to keep animals. So when people are bored, they abandon their pets, which causes new problems in human life today. In this case, we created a mobile application that can be shared with pet lovers where they can share information about abandoned pets and the possibility of owning pets from these abandoned pets. Mobile applications were designed using use case diagrams to show business processes, class diagrams to show database models, and user interfaces to present a similar interface to users. This mobile application will become a platform that can gather all people who care about pets and make pets a part of humans.

articleTitle: DataHarbour: Enabling Decentalized AI Data Marketplace using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence revolutionizes digital applications through simulation of human intelligence in machines, driving unprecedented progress in technology and decision-making. By adeptly processing large volumes of data, AI systems excel in pattern recognition, learning from experience, and autonomously making decisions. However, the present AI ecosystem suffers from data inequity, with major corporations dominating the market while smaller businesses still struggling. Access to AI data is the privilege of tech giants. In this paper, we propose DataHarbour, a blockchain-based marketplace that addresses issues with AI data access. DataHarbour's decentralized platform seeks to democratize data access and promote cooperation. Built on blockchain– a disruptive emerging technology that buttresses decentralized systems, it leverages smart contracts, incorporates data verification, and a reputation system. This paper also delineates the design and operation of AI data market place and portrays the system’s ability to foster a more inclusive AI environment. DataHarbour aims to accelerate AI innovation and close the data divide by facilitating safe data interchange and fostering integrity.

articleTitle: SD-SmartCert: A Blockchain-Based Certification System with Selective Disclosure
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The research paper explores the concept of selective disclosure within blockchain networks, addressing the tension between transparency and privacy. It introduces cryptographic schemes that allow users to reveal only necessary information, maintaining confidentiality. The paper analyzes various selective disclosure methods, such as Zero-Knowledge Proofs and Attribute-Based Encryption, highlighting their applications in enhancing privacy and security in digital transactions. It also discusses the implementation of these schemes in blockchain for certification system, emphasizing their potential to foster trust and promote wider adoption of blockchain technology across different industries. The paper concludes by identifying future research directions to optimize these cryptographic protocols for better scalability and interoperability in blockchain systems.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Powered Financial Service Platform: Enabling P2P Payments, Crowdfunding and Loans
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: This paper provides an in-depth analysis of a financial services platform that utilizes blockchain technology for peer-to-peer payments, crowdfunding, and loan services. By leveraging blockchain, the platform guarantees security, transparency, and efficiency in all transactions, offering a transformative alternative to traditional financial systems. It establishes a decentralized environment where users can interact and transact directly with one another, removing the need for intermediaries. Peer-to-peer payments allow for quick and effortless fund transfers between users, while crowdfunding supports the collection of capital for various projects or initiatives through numerous small contributions. Moreover, the platform includes loan services, enabling users to borrow funds in a secure and transparent manner, with smart contracts managing the loan process and ensuring compliance with repayment terms. The integration of blockchain technology on our platform aims to democratize financial services, enhance financial inclusion, and build trust within the financial system.

articleTitle: AI based Security in computer vision and machine learning algorithms for hand sign recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: In order to facilitate intuitive control and communication across a variety of areas, hand gesture recognition is an essential component of human-computer interaction systems. In this paper, a real-time hand gesture recognition system developed with the MediaPipe library, and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) is presented. The system utilizes a CNN model provided by MediaPipe for accurate detection of hand landmarks in camera feed images. Through extensive preprocessing and feature extraction, hand gestures, including finger gestures and palm orientations, are classified in real-time. The system offers dynamic selection between two modes: logging key points and logging point history, facilitating data collection for training or analysis purposes.Key features of the system include bounding rectangle calculation, landmark visualization, and gesture classification, providing users with immediate feedback on detected hand gestures. The modular design and parameter configurability make the system versatile for a wide range of applications, from interactive interfaces to sign language interpretation. The outcomes of the experiments showcase the practicality and efficacy of the suggested method, indicating that it has the potential to improve the experiences of people interacting with computers. Incorporating AI security measures, the system can significantly enhance security protocols in various applications. For instance, it can be used for gesture-based authentication, where specific hand gestures act as passwords to grant access to secure systems. This method can be further secured by combining it with traditional authentication techniques, creating a robust multi-factor authentication framework. Additionally, the real-time detection capability allows for immediate response to unauthorized access attempts, triggering alerts or lockdown procedures when unfamiliar gestures are detected.

articleTitle: Modern Traffic Safety Solution with GSM & GPS Enabled Speed Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The goal of this research is to increase road safety by measuring wheel RPM and identifying instances of over speeding using an inductive proximity sensor. An SMS warning is sent to a specified mobile number by the Atmega328 microcontroller, which analyses the sensor data and detects an RPM above a predetermined limit. The device, which has a GPS module, records location in real time and shows latitude and longitude on a 16 by 2 LCD panel. The prototype's wheel is simulated by a DC fan whose speed is adjusted by a potentiometer and which is placed in front of the sensor with a metal object. The technology sounds a siren and sends out a warning when the fan's RPM goes above the threshold. LEDs also give the driver a visual indicator of their speed. When the device reaches over speed, a relay driver regulates the DC fan; data processing and control are handled by the Atmega328 microcontroller, which is based on the Arduino Uno.

articleTitle: Unified Data Handling for Vulnerability Detection and Mitigation in Smart Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: A new era of connectedness and simplicity has arrived because of the Internet of Things (IoT) adoption. However, this interconnectedness also introduces significant security challenges, as IoT devices are susceptible to various vulnerabilities that malicious users can exploit. Traditional vulnerability discovery methods often fall short in addressing the dynamic and heterogeneous nature of IoT ecosystems. In this paper, we propose an integrated approach that combines data preprocessing, cleaning, and reduction techniques to enhance vulnerability discovery and mitigation in smart systems. We begin by discussing the importance of each of these data processing steps and their role in preparing raw data for analysis. Subsequently, we explore specific methodologies for data preprocessing, cleaning, and reduction, tailored to the unique characteristics of smart system data. We then illustrate how these techniques can be seamlessly integrated into a comprehensive framework for vulnerability analysis, from data ingestion to mitigation strategy formulation. Through case studies or experimental validation, we demonstrate the efficacy of our proposed approach in improving the efficiency and accuracy of vulnerability discovery and mitigation efforts. Overall, this paper contributes to the advancement of security measures in smart systems by providing a systematic and holistic approach to data-driven vulnerability management. This comprehensive approach ensures data consistency, integration, and correctness, ultimately enhancing the reliability and security of smart systems.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Framework for Low-Rate DDoS Detection in Cloud Environments Using Decision Tree Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: An adaptive detection framework to identify low-rate Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks in cloud environments. Leveraging the Decision Tree machine learning algorithm, the framework offers a proactive approach to identifying and mitigating these attacks. By adapting to the dynamic nature of cloud environments, the framework enhances detection accuracy while minimizing false positives. Through experimentation and evaluation, the efficacy of the proposed approach is demonstrated, showcasing its potential to bolster security measures in cloud infrastructures against DDoS threats. Low-rate DDoS attacks make detection particularly difficult. Meanwhile, cloud infrastructure is rapidly evolving with container-based technology allowing efficient resource utilization and flexible service scaling. Existing methods for detecting DDoS attacks in cloud computing are insufficient against low-rate DDoS attacks, requiring a method capable of both identifying and preventing them to some extent. The Adaptive Framework is designed specifically for cloud environments, considering the dynamic nature of cloud infrastructure and the necessity for scalable and efficient detection mechanisms. The core detection mechanism relies on a Decision Tree Machine Learning Algorithm known for its framework offers high interpretability and can effectively process both categorical and numerical data. Decision trees partition the data based on features, making them suitable for capturing patterns in network traffic indicative of low-rate DDoS attacks. The framework likely accommodates the scalability requirements of cloud environments, given the dynamic scaling of resources inherent in cloud computing.

articleTitle: PassChain: A Blockchain-Based Decentralized Password Manager
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: A Nobel approach to the password management system is introduced in this paper, which is through a decentralized system named blockchain. Our goal is to secure people’s passwords by providing them with a secure and distributed password management system named "PassChain." In today’s digital world, a secure password management system is crucial, but it is still challenging. The traditional system lacks security and is a centralized system, so trust issues also arise. Our proposed blockchain-based solution offers full control over users’ passwords. Because of the decentralized method, they are not stored on a single server. Decentralized servers are also more secure than databases. This approach will ensure user security and privacy and will also reduce dependency on third-party services that are prone to vulnerabilities.

articleTitle: Blockchain based Digital Multimedia Content Authentication System: using IPFS and Ethereum
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: In the era of digital technology, the widespread availability of multimedia content has presented major challenges in confirming the genuineness and reliability of digital media. This paper introduces a novel technology that utilizes the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) and Ethereum to authenticate multimedia content, ensuring its provenance and prohibiting tampering. The suggested approach brings together a decentralized ledger system with cryptographic hashing and smart contracts to create an immutable record of content ownership and modification history. By integrating cryptographic hashes of multimedia files into blockchain transactions, we establish a secure, transparent, and tamper-proof mechanism for tracking content authenticity. Our methodology improves confidence and dependability in digital media by establishing a strong structure for creators, distributors, and consumers to authenticate the authenticity of multimedia materials. Experimental results confirm the effectiveness and efficiency of our system in preserving the integrity of various types of multimedia content, laying the path for a wider utilization areas such as digital rights management, content distribution, and forensic analysis, etc.

articleTitle: Enhancing Software Reliability Through Machine Learning: Prediction Through Evaluation Metrics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Predicting and managing software faults is crucial in modern development, demanding costeffective and dependable strategies. Traditional approaches based on historical data or modulespecific insights frequently fall short of predictive capabilities. To address this, an automated machine learning-based defect prediction model is proposed, enabling proactive error detection and resolution, thus enhancing software performance and efficiency. This ensures seamless task continuity and bolsters software resilience. Comprehensive evaluation metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall, specificity, F1 measure, and tenfold cross-validation, ensure thorough performance assessment. Integration of DevSecOps principles becomes imperative for bolstering code security and vulnerability mitigation. By leveraging machine learning for defect prediction, the DevSecOps pipeline is strengthened, facilitating early threat identification and mitigation. Prioritizing testing efforts based on predicted fault likelihood enhances resource allocation, optimizing efficiency and software quality. Moreover, a novel methodology automatically extracts semantic representations from source code, bridging the semantic gap inherent in traditional defect prediction systems. Experimental validation using diverse datasets highlights the efficacy of the proposed technique, surpassing established approaches like PCA, LDA, and Kernel PCA(KPCA) in capturing intricate program semantics. Using several classifiers like decision tree, Naïve Bayes, Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) , and SVM, achieved the accuracy in the article, up to 73 % and by merging all datasets and improving deep learning models i.e. ANN we achieved the papers highest accuracy of up to 95 %. In conclusion, this study presents a comprehensive methodology combining machine learning and deep learning based DevSecOps principles to enhance software defect prediction and testing. By leveraging advanced techniques, software professionals can anticipate and address faults, fortify security, and optimize resource utilization, thereby improving software reliability and efficiency in contemporary development scenarios.

articleTitle: Blockchain Integration for Secure Health Data Management
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Blockchain has acquired a lot of consideration in recent times for its technology and methods to revolutionize many valuable industries such as healthcare. Blockchain technology’s decentralized structure makes it an ideal incitement for the urgently required shift to unified healthcare, contribution latest outlook and approaching some of the vital issues facing numerous healthcare specialties. This paper provides an exhaustive and careful overview of blockchain applications in the medical and healthcare domains. Proposed architecture is used for secure sharing of health data using blockchain. Overall, this survey contributes to understanding the Promises and restrictions with combining blockchain into medical practices, preparing the route for increased data security and confidentiality with patient medical care.

articleTitle: Securing Balloting Systems through Iris Scan and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The current voting systems used in political elections in India have appeared to be prone to security breaches, with individuals voting more than once to create biased results in favor of their favorite candidates which eventually results in eroding and loosening up the common public’s trust. The objective of this paper is to propose a verification system for voting booths. This system will detect if the individual about to cast a vote has already cast it once and is trying to do it again to help create a biased result by tampering with the votes. By using Haar cascade, Hough Circles Transform, LBP, and Bhattacharya Distance, this paper aims to provide a more secure and robust verification system for voting booths.

articleTitle: IoT-based System to Integrate with Wheelchair for Disable Person
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of an Internet of Things (IoT)-enabled wheelchair system using the ESP32 microcontroller platform. The project aims to enhance the mobility and quality of life for individuals with limited mobility by integrating various sensors, connectivity options like Bluetooth And wifi, and a user-friendly mobile application. The ESP32 microcontroller is employed as the central processing unit to gather data from sensors, communicate wirelessly with a mobile app, and control the wheelchair's movement. The wheelchair is equipped with ultrasonic sensors to detect obstacles and ensure safe navigation.

articleTitle: Unlocking the Potential of Blockchain Integration in Secured Framework of Mental Health
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The assessment of mental health within modern healthcare systems has become increasingly complex, particularly when implemented on IoT-supported platforms. This paper explores the potential of a blockchain framework to utilize the trivial properties of EEG in order to enhance the applicability, efficiency and effectiveness of mental health assessment. Blockchain ensures secure and tamper-proof storage of mental health data, enables seamless data integration from diverse IoT sources, and fosters trust and transparency among participants. The decentralized and immutable nature of blockchain is expected to enhance security of EEG data, ensuring its integrity and interoperability. It also incentivizes data sharing, facilitates research collaboration, and reduces costs associated with data management and exchange. These technologies have the potential to revolutionize mental health care, leading to more precise and effective assessment techniques, personalized interventions, and improved outcomes for individuals seeking mental health support. Furthermore, the integration of AI and analytics on blockchain-integrated systems may support collaborative research, paving the way for more effective and innovative solutions to improve diagnostic accuracy.

articleTitle: Design And Implementation of Public Distribution System Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: The persistent issue of food grain wastage due to inefficient storage, transportation, and management at Fair Price Shops within the Public Distribution System (PDS) demands innovative solutions. A decentralized PDS model utilizing blockchain technology is proposed to enhance transparency and accountability in the supply chain. Blockchain provides precise monitoring across food grain procurement, transportation, and storage processes, yielding valuable insights into potential areas of wastage and facilitating efficient auditing. Enhanced traceability within this system helps minimize wastage, detect suspicious activities, and streamline auditing and record-keeping in the food supply chain. The adoption of blockchain fosters a culture of accountability and responsible practices while introducing automation to the distribution process. Additionally, blockchain's proven capabilities in improving food traceability address existing challenges related to system reliability, scalability, and accuracy. Integrating blockchain with IoT further strengthens data integrity and boosts efficiency. Examples such as blockchain-enabled crop insurance and platforms like AgroChain demonstrate its potential to transform agriculture through increased transparency, efficiency, and trust. However, challenges like scalability, energy consumption, and infrastructural constraints need to be addressed for widespread implementation. The evolution of the PDS, particularly under the Targeted Public Distribution System (TPDS) and the National Food Security Act (NFSA), underscores the need for enhanced supply chain management to ensure food security. Blockchain technology offers a promising approach to improving the reliability, accountability, and efficiency of the PDS, promoting the equitable distribution of essential goods.

articleTitle: A Collaborative Health Care System: A Pilot based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: Blockchain-driven healthcare system that offers personalized, data-driven treatment options hopes to transform the medical industry. This system aims to increase diagnostic accuracy, treatment efficacy, and data security. It strongly emphasizes the value of interdisciplinary collaboration among medical professionals, enabling various professions to work together to provide comprehensive care for complex medical conditions. It also addresses the ethical and legal concerns that result from cross-specialty cooperation and the exchange of patient data, including as patient privacy and data security.

articleTitle: Exploring the Potential of Sin-GAN for Image Generation and Manipulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Blockchain and Distributed Systems Security (ICBDS)
abstract: SinGAN (Single Image Generative Adversarial Networks) has emerged as a promising approach for image generation and manipulation tasks. This paper explores the potential of SinGAN in enhancing various Era and manipulation responsibilities. This paper explores the capability of SinGAN in improving numerous components of picture synthesis, including technology, manipulation, and recovery. By leveraging a hierarchical architecture, SinGAN enables the technology of wonderful photographs from a unmarried enter photo, facilitating various applications in laptop imaginative and prescient and pix.
